SigningSmoke: Passed on a separate copy of the official 1.0.0 installer; repeated signing passed; tampered copy rejected
Limitations: Static window layouts use no hardware data and do not run code-behind event handlers.
Third-party application names, user paths and native Windows messages are not translated by the application dictionary.
The transition release is downloaded by old clients using their existing update mechanism.
Private-key backup still needs an offline copy on a separate device.
